normative_claims.text: HG-KSEOS is the sole normative WorkOrder/admission/reducer/release control plane; Hermes is the governed orchestration plane and Fabric only the contract surface.
The 2026-10-09 audit is a user-supplied defect list that outranks project design docs but never replaces the upper specification.
Product writes require an admitted HGK WorkOrder, a bounded WriteSet and a git baseline/rollback pointer.
PROMPT_COMPILE_PASS may only be produced by the bundled deterministic compiler.
A candidate file being present, non-empty or schema-valid is not runtime readiness.

intent.goal: 在現有 PIPD-LS-SP public Repo 與 S0~S4 基線上，以 NARROW_REPAIR 修補 2026-10-09 外部破壞性稽核的 R-AUD-001~015 全部問題與 FW-01~12 全部最小修補工單，並以同一 frozen candidate 取得獨立驗收官判定。
intent.user_expected_outcome: R-AUD-001~015 全部具正確 disposition 與程式／契約／證據對應；FW-01~12 各有 fresh receipt；S0~S4 所有 applicable hard gate 在同一候選上獨立複驗；PRE-W3 維持 TEMP_CLOSED。
intent.user_expected_experience: 使用者以自然語言即可觸發 lifecycle 並取得綁來源的 PI/PD 契約；8 Skills、5 Web、3 Host、13 CLI 的失敗一律以 typed error 呈現，不以檔案存在或非空 JSON 冒充可用。
explicit_constraints: HG-KSEOS 為唯一控制平面；Hermes 為受治理 Runtime/Orchestration Plane；Fabric 僅為契約面
產品寫入限 PIPD target root；GitHub 只更新既有 public Repo，不重建、不 force-push
不得建立第二 WorkOrder／RBWI／Reducer／Canonical IR／SharedSpine
不得以改測例、改 Gate 分母、提高 PASS 百分比或修改 Oracle 換取 PASS
不得推進 S5+／PRE-W3／Fabric RP-002 SQP1／Stage-3／production
所有一般工程決策自行以 FAR 研究裁決，不因技術歧義反覆詢問使用者
non_goals: Fabric sealed RP-002／SQP1／Stage-3 修改與 production deployment
authorized_mutations: PIPD 產品根目錄內檔案新增／修改／搬移／刪除／重構（含新建 skills/、dist/、tools/）
更新既有公開 Repo shw097-team/PIPD-LS-SP 與單一驗收證據 MD
建立 HGK requirement／taskspec／workorder／checkpoint 與 Kanban 卡
執行 FAR 研究並輸出 Gate-1 決策（研究層，非 acceptance）
forbidden_mutations: 建立第二控制平面／SharedSpine／Reducer／Task DB／Canonical Plan IR
對 SharedSpine 作原生 SQL 寫入
PIPD root 以外未經 admission 的寫入
Maker 自批獨立驗收或自我晉升
公開任何憑證內容／PAT 前後綴
修改 Fabric sealed control 或 HG-KSEOS 封存控制面
force-push 覆蓋公開 main 或改寫歷史 commit

must_not_reopen: 已於基線存在的 19 個 schema 檔之非衝突欄位語意（僅可一致化與加測，不得刪欄位令測試過關）

work_required: re-freeze {source,repo,manifest,policy,checker,toolchain} tuple on one candidate at HEAD and produce raw AO receipts
materialize 8 logical SkillContracts (SKILL.md, references/contract.md, references/examples.md, schemas/input+output, tests/cases.yaml) and prove discover->effective-load->trigger/non-trigger
replace the 5-axis keyword classifier with a clause-bound atomic requirement compiler carrying stable SRC->REQ/Child->SPEC->ACC->VER->EVD->DEL->GATE trace and per-clause oracles
emit the exact five PIPD semantic Web documents from the typed projection IR with source hashes, capability-loss and stale-source negative
build real generic-skills / hgk-receiver / genie-adapter adapters with effective-load, semantic parity, compatibility-loss and stub/permission-widen negatives
replace hardcoded/empty payload projection with a declarative typed projection IR compiled from canonical objects, profile and adapter mapping
bind PD to real git/host RepoContext (head, dirty tree, manifest, currentness epoch, permission); caller-supplied FRESH becomes a claim only
re-run GP-01/02/03 and all 13 CLI commands on a fresh runner with raw stdout/stderr/exit, per-command contract, negative/refusal paths, perf and rollback
per-source owner disposition for the 7 quarantined sources with false-positive proof and malicious negative controls; no unreviewed fill-up to 160/160
canonical self-exclusion plus external immutable seal over the evidence manifest, byte-level readback and self-hash-cycle / foreign-manifest negatives
run a non-maker clean-room VERIFY_ONLY officer on the frozen candidate and receiver the raw verdict
